method: Chained OPERA DISP-S1 products (each relative to its own reference date) after subtracting the reference-patch median from every product; ordinary least-squares slope of cumulative LOS displacement vs. time.
limitations: LOS velocity, not vertical subsidence. Positive = toward the satellite.
Standard error assumes independent residuals; real uncertainty is larger (temporal correlation, seasonal clay motion).
The reference patch is provisional and unreviewed; a moving reference biases every velocity.
A cell is included only if it passes the valid-pixel (>= 25%) and water checks in every product in the chosen chain; incomplete time series are withheld rather than imputed.
Provisional: reference region and processing choices have not yet been reviewed by the team.
reference_method: Pre-registered region A (config/preregistration.json v1.1): every cell within 3 km of GPS stations DEN2, TMCC, which are continuous, long-history, and moved less than 1 mm/yr vertically. Provisional until the full-series cell list is frozen (plan B3).
